scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck -w @sabame/api && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:architecture && npm run test -w @sabame/catalog && npm run test -w @sabame/web --
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @sabame/domain && npm run build -w @sabame/catalog
scripts.predev: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @sabame/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @sabame/api
scripts.build:all: npm run build:api && npm run build
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @sabame/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @sabame/api
scripts.test:catalog: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @sabame/catalog
scripts.predev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate
